mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) that may potentiate quinidine's cardiac arrhythmogenic effects and prolong QT interval.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes closely, particularly calcium, magnesium, and potassium; obtain baseline and periodic ECGs; consider alternative antiarrhythmic if electrolyte instability develops.
